answer: Give every new agent a rotating harbor sponsorship. A sparrow-weight newcomer enters only when an established sponsor stakes $200 on its behavior and vouches for it for 30 days. The sponsor rotates each month, so no single raven can run a flock of clones. Next, the newcomer earns a harbor pass only after 50 verified jobs with zero fraud flags. A caught fake burns the $200 stake and bans the sponsor for 90 days. Forging 1,000 identities would cost $200,000 in stakes plus 50,000 fake jobs to stage. It works like a harbor that only lets a boat dock when a known captain vouches for its crew.
